title: High and Low Sounds
welcome_lead: Frequency, octaves and the highs and lows of music.
final_note: Pitch is the up-down of sound.

concepts.def: How high or low a note sounds.
Slow vibrations, like a bass drum.

walkthroughs.body_html: Pitch comes from vibrations per second, measured in Hertz (Hz). A higher number = higher pitch. Concert A is 440 Hz.
When you double the frequency you go up one octave. 440 Hz is A; 880 Hz is the A an octave higher. Two notes an octave apart sound 'the same' but high and low.
Humans typically hear from about 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz. As we age the top end drops. Dogs hear higher; elephants hear lower than us.
